core:
Create a sprite source atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns x2 rows, 8 isolated drawings. Transparent background, NO text or lines. One heavy adult TYRANNOSAURUS REX, fossil accurate, same copper RED-BROWN dark-striped colors as reference. Reference defines OVERHEAD CAMERA and scale, do NOT copy its sprawling legs. Pixel art at game resolution, enlarged hard pixels, angular muscular facets. NO BLACK OUTLINES AT ALL. NO dark edge rims or outlines on these parts! Color extends to the silhouette edge. Interior shadows, dark back stripe and mouth lines allowed, but no perimeter stroke. Light upper LEFT for every direction.
TOP ROW: four complete torso-with-tail drawings. NO head, neck, legs, arms or claws attached. A broad powerful ribcage and hip muscles, continuous long stiff tail as counterweight smoothly attached without any line or cut at its base. Horizontally carried body. Native torso about34x38 (S/N), 45x32 (E/W); tail about48 pixels long. Muscular angular surfaces, NOT a sausage, no round smooth balls. Copper/russet #8d6042 #b98252 #c6663c #913b32 #674333 with charcoal/dark brown transverse tiger stripes, gold copper upper-left highlights. Same mass all directions.
r1c1 SOUTH torso chest DOWN hips above long tail UP.
r1c2 NORTH torso chest UP hips below long tail DOWN.
r1c3 EAST torso chest RIGHT hips left long tail LEFT.
r1c4 WEST torso chest LEFT hips right long tail RIGHT. Independently drawn upper-left highlights, NOT mirrored from east.
BOTTOM ROW: four complete short thick muscular NECK + enormous HEAD drawings, seamless neck/skull connection, mouth CLOSED, no exposed teeth except one or two thick ivory tooth tips if visible. NO thin snout, NO horns, NO Allosaurus crests. T-rex has a DEEP, BROAD, BOXY skull, wide back of skull, moderately narrower blunt rectangular snout, heavy lower jaw, small rough supraorbital bony knobs, forward-angled eyes. Heavy terrifying boss. Neck short and THICK (as wide as back of skull), skull native28x29 (S/N) or33x24(E/W). Neck root skin covered and rounded, no stump/cut faces. Skull top and both brow corners visible in overhead view; only slight near-side jaw surface, NEVER pure lateral profile. Two fingers on T-rex arms but NO arms in these drawings.
r2c1 SOUTH neck root TOP, broad BOX snout points DOWN.
r2c2 NORTH neck root BOTTOM, broad BOX snout points UP.
r2c3 EAST neck root LEFT, huge BOX snout RIGHT.
r2c4 WEST neck root RIGHT, huge BOX snout LEFT. Fresh drawing, same light upper left.
Use style and copper/rust identity of reference, increase fossil skull robustness, preserve dorsal camera. NO outline stroke, NO black or dark border at any attachment. No chopped faces, no external shadows. These continuous sources will be separated into articulated cutout parts afterward. Transparent empty areas between 8 cells.
S:
Draw exactly a 3 columns x3 rows isolated CUTOUT PARTS ATLAS for adult TYRANNOSAURUS REX, one direction in neutral rest pose. Camera from ABOVE with only slight visible side, matching the reference. Copper/russet/red-brown skin with dark transverse tiger stripes and angular muscle facets. No black outlines, NO dark perimeter rim, NO dark borders on joint caps. Color goes right to outer edge! Dark markings and interior mouth lines are allowed. Transparent background, NO text grid lines arrows or labels. Draw every part COMPLETE including ALL hidden attachment surfaces and the FAR leg, which is just as fully drawn as the near leg. Large rounded skin-covered attachment caps, not severed faces. All attachable segments should overlap 3 native pixels at each joint. Use Primal Earth copper #8d6042 #b98252 #c6663c #913b32 #674333 #d4a36c, brown stripe #443027, ivory claws #edd0a0. Light always screen upper LEFT. Pixel art, hard pixels, same bold sparse scale texture as reference. NO smooth 3D balls.
The 9 cells, row-major:
1 THIGH_L upper hindleg only, angular huge muscular thigh, hip to knee, no shin or toes.
2 SHIN_L entire LONG shin only, larger knee cap to narrower ankle cap, no foot/claws.
3 FOOT_L entire three-toed bird foot with thick toes, short bone claws, rounded ankle cap.
4 THIGH_R whole FAR upper hindleg, same muscular mass as near, no missing surfaces.
5 SHIN_R whole FAR long shin, knee to ankle, no foot.
6 FOOT_R whole FAR three-toed bird foot and short claws.
7 ARM_L entire TINY forelimb with TWO FINGERS only, two small hooked claws, shoulder to elbow to palm. Arms about ONE THIRD foot size. NO third finger.
8 ARM_R complete other tiny TWO-FINGER forelimb with only TWO claws.
9 JAW alone, entire lower mandible of T-rex, deep muscular BOX shape, rounded massive jaw hinge, blunt wide chin, heavy tooth bearing edge with a few thick short teeth at top edge, closed-mouth anatomical pose. Not a thin alligator mandible. Copper/red-brown skin, ivory teeth. NO upper skull.
All part sizes physically consistent: thigh native13x19, shin7x16, foot10x13 (S/N) or15x9 (E/W), tiny arm5x7, jaw24x10(E/W) or20x25(S/N). Leave plenty of transparent space. The muscle surfaces have no edge strokes and no outline at ANY joint. The pieces will be registered under a thick heavy torso afterward.
DIRECTION: SOUTH, animal faces DOWN. Thighs hip TOP and knee BOTTOM; shins knee TOP ankle BOTTOM; feet ankle TOP and 3 toes DOWN. JAW hinge TOP and blunt wide chin DOWN. Arms shoulder TOP with two small fingers curling inward/down. Anatomical LEFT is screen RIGHT. Legs are VERTICAL under body like a BIRD: do NOT angle outward/splay. Every leg segment is narrow in screen X and long in screen Y.

corrections:
Six isolated TYRANNOSAURUS cutout parts in EXACT 3 columns x2 rows, transparent background. No text grid labels. Copper red-brown skin, dark tiger stripes, ivory thick teeth, top-left light. NO outlines, NO dark edge stroke at joints or outer edges. Pixelart enlarged hard pixels, angular muscles.
r1c1 NORTH LEFT THIGH: in view FROM ABOVE, the HIP attachment is at the BOTTOM and is BROAD, heavily muscled. It tapers UPWARD to a SMALL ROUND KNEE at the TOP. The thigh points UP, not down. Full hidden hip surface, not cut face. No shin/foot.
r1c2 NORTH RIGHT THIGH: HIP at BOTTOM, small KNEE at TOP, heavily muscled hip widening toward BOTTOM. Redraw its lighting from screen upper-left. No shin/foot. Hip is NOT at top.
r1c3 SOUTH LOWER JAW ONLY viewed FROM ABOVE: a wide U-shaped mandibular horseshoe with BOTH jaw hinges at the UPPER corners, joining a deep thick BLUNT CHIN at BOTTOM. Copper skin and thick tooth row along interior upper surface. Round wide hinge ends. No upper skull. Dorsal mandible U shape, not a side-profile jaw. Adult T-rex fossil broad powerful mandible, native22 wide x25 long.
r2c1 NORTH LOWER JAW ONLY viewed FROM ABOVE: the same mandible U shape facing UP. BOTH hinges at LOWER corners and the blunt chin joining the two sides at TOP. Native22x25, copper skin, tooth rows interior.
r2c2 EAST LOWER JAW ONLY overhead with a little near side: large rounded hinge LEFT, deep blocky body and blunt chin RIGHT. Powerful adult T-rex lower mandible, native30 long x12 deep, thick tooth row along TOP edge. Not an upper skull, no nostrils or eyes.
r2c3 WEST LOWER JAW ONLY overhead with little near side: rounded hinge RIGHT, blunt chin LEFT, tooth row along TOP edge, redraw top-left light independently. Native30x12.
Every attachment end round, fully covered by skin, no stump or cross section. All parts are complete including hidden flanges and hinges. No outlines at all, no cast shadows. Thick T-rex mandibles, no spindly crocodile jaws. Same copper/russet #8d6042 #b98252 #c6663c #913b32 #674333 #d4a36c, dark stripe #443027, ivory #edd0a0.
